requirements.text: * Technical & Craft Expertise: Proven experience as a Full-Stack Software Engineer building modern, scalable applications across both the frontend and backend. Typescript + Python is what we use.

* AI Tooling Fluency: Hands-on experience and deep comfort using AI coding tools. Have the ability to clearly express your intent and exercise good judgement to direct AI to produce clear and maintainable code (not AI slop).
* Startup Mentality: An aggressively entrepreneurial spirit with a track record of moving fast, cutting through red tape, and delivering results quickly.
* Customer Obsession: A strong desire to be close to the customer, with demonstrated experience running A/B tests, prototypes, or rapid user experiments.
* Adaptability & Autonomy: The ability to self-direct, pivot rapidly when hypotheses are disproven, and thrive in an unstructured, highly ambiguous environment.
* Growth Mindset: A relentless appetite for learning new technologies, taking calculated risks, and having a blast while building the future.
